prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Production 2D combat sprites for Mouse Frontier, matching the referenced APPROVED creature exactly: same species/anatomy, silhouette, face, proportions, palette, materials, pixel-art outline and shading. NEW authored intermediate poses, never rotations/duplicates of one picture. Transparent RGBA background, clean alpha in all gaps; no scenery, shadows, text, labels or grid. Layout EXACTLY 6 equal columns x 4 rows, 1536x1024, 24 cells256x256. ONE complete creature in every cell, 16px edge clearance, consistent scale, fixed camera and baseline. Default face RIGHT in matching three-quarter profile; a front-facing reference can retain its approved view. Animate left to right in each row. Row1 MELEE: ready, prepare/wind-up, launch, maximum strike, follow-through, recovery to ready. Row2 RANGED: ready, prepare, aim/charge, release, recoil, recover. Row3 HIT: ready, initial flinch, recoil, maximum stagger, regain balance, return ready (do NOT fall fully over in a survivable hit). Row4 DEATH: ready, buckle/weaken, begin falling, collapse, settle, motionless final downed body with closed eyes. Last row never revives or loops. No gore. No extra accessories or limbs.  CRITICAL: all 24 cells must contain a COMPLETE creature body, even at the release frame. Keep effects small and immediately beside the body; NEVER use an effect-only cell. Max body width210px and max height210px inside each256px cell.Exactly this slender upright PURPLE dragon with narrow horned head, pale grey belly/scales, long purple tail, TWO legs, TWO small clawed arms and TWO big purple wings with pale grey-green membranes. Preserve single head and lean original silhouette, do not turn it into a bulky dinosaur. Face right, same three-quarter view, all limbs/tail/wings fit eachcell. Melee claw swipe then bite; ranged modest purple-grey breath from the ONE mouth (keep whole dragon visible); hit wings fold and torso recoils; death knees buckle, wings fold, full dragon lies down with closed eye, tail intact.
